lines.line: Zameen *flat* hai, aur ye Quran mein likha hai.

options.visual: 0.0 s: a real 19th-century flat-earth map (Gleason 1892, public domain) fills the frame, already pushing in. 0.8 s: the word FLAT? slams on in giant type. 1.4 s: a phone-screen viral post slides over it with the claim.
options.sound: impact on frame 0, paper whoosh on the post
options.why: Frame 0 is a bold, strange real object that reads at thumbnail size; the key word lands by 0.8 s.

options.visual: 0.0 s: NASA Blue Marble earth, full frame, rotating. 0.7 s: it is crushed flat into a disc with a thud. 1.4 s: a VIRAL CLAIM post slaps onto the disc.
options.why: The contradiction (round globe squashed flat) reads with the sound off.

options.visual: 0.0 s: B&W cut-out of the earth on one bold orange ground, a ruler laid across it. 0.8 s: giant word FLAT drops in front. 1.4 s: a stamped QURAN? tag.
options.why: yevorqq collage grammar: one subject, strong contrast, giant keyword.

lines.line: Jawab milta hai, "Nahi bhai, Quran ne toh zameen ko *anda* bola hai."

options.visual: 2.7 s: hard cut to a second viral post: an ostrich egg photo beside the earth, "Quran said EGG". 4.2 s: the egg and the earth snap side by side, each with a ? stamp.
options.sound: whip on the cut, pop on the egg
options.why: A new real image every 1.5 s; sets up the two-sided reel visually.

options.visual: Top half: the second post. Bottom half: a real ostrich egg rolls into frame and stops beside the globe.
options.why: Both claims on screen together; the comparison is the hook.

options.visual: Same orange collage world as option C of line 1: the ruler is swapped for a giant cut-out egg that pushes the earth aside.
options.why: Continues the collage hook if line 1 picks C.

lines.line: Maine dono check kiye. Sach bataun? Dono hi galat nikle.

options.visual: Creator appears at the sentence break; both posts shrink to small cards either side of the creator; at "dono hi galat" each gets a red FALSE stamp.
options.why: QUALITY 1: creator after the hook, at a sentence break; the double stamp is the reel's promise.

options.visual: Plain talking head; at "galat" one card above the head: BOTH WRONG.
options.why: Calmer; saves the stamps for the payoff.

lines.line: Pehle flat wala. Surah Ghashiyah ke verse 20 mein word hai, "sutihat" (سُطِحَتْ).

options.visual: Torn paper card with 88:20 in Arabic (fetched), orange 88:20 tag; push-in to the word, ringed by hand in orange.
options.sound: paper rustle, pen scratch on the ring
options.why: The reel stands on one word; show the word itself.

options.visual: Same card, creator in a circle bottom-left so "pehle flat wala" stays personal.
options.why: Keeps the speaker's energy while the card holds.

lines.line: Matlab, *bichha dena*. Jaise chadar bichhate hain.

options.visual: Real footage: a sheet (chadar) flicked out and settling flat on a bed; beside it: sutihat = spread out.
options.why: The line's analogy is literal footage, so the meaning lands without reading.

options.visual: Card: sutihat = spread out (Tabari, Qurtubi, Ibn Kathir).
options.why: Simpler if the chadar shot is hard to get.

lines.line: Par baat kis cheez ki ho rahi hai? Thoda peeche padho.

options.visual: Punch-in on "kis cheez ki"; on "thoda peeche padho" the Ayah card slides up to reveal 88:17-19 above 88:20.
options.why: The question is the viewer's own; the slide starts the answer.

options.visual: The 88:20 card zooms out to show 88:17-20 stacked as four torn strips.
options.why: Shows that one verse was cut out of four.

lines.line: Quran poochta hai, ye log oont ko nahi dekhte? Aasmaan ko, pahadon ko?

options.visual: 88:17-19 strips in Arabic (fetched) with an English gloss each: CAMELS, SKY, MOUNTAINS; each strip gets a small real photo as it is spoken.
options.why: Each word is a picture; the strips make the list countable.

options.visual: Top: speaker. Bottom: real photos cut on the beat: camel, sky, mountains.
options.why: Keeps the speaker's questioning face while the list is shown.

lines.line: Aur zameen ko, ki wo kaise *bichhayi* gayi?

options.visual: The 88:20 strip joins the stack; real photo of desert ground underfoot; the word ringed again.
options.text: ...and the earth, how it was spread out
options.sound: tick, then soft hit on the ring
options.why: Completes the four and calls back the word.

options.visual: Speaker; a card with four icons in a row.
options.why: Lighter version.

lines.line: Socho, registan mein ek aadmi oont pe baitha hai. Yahi chaar cheezein toh uske saamne hain.

options.visual: Real wide desert footage, a camel rider small in frame; four labels appear on what he sees: CAMEL, SKY, MOUNTAINS, GROUND.
options.why: The scene the tafsir describes (Qurtubi, Razi), shown, not said.

options.visual: Same footage with the speaker in a circle.
options.why: If "socho" needs the creator's face.

lines.line: Baat uske pairon ke neeche ki zameen ki hai. Planet ki shape ki nahi.

options.visual: Camera tilts from the rider down to the sand at his feet: THE GROUND UNDER HIS FEET; then a tiny globe with PLANET SHAPE crossed out.
options.text: The ground under his feet, not the planet's shape
options.why: One move carries the whole point: from his feet, not from space.

options.visual: Speaker; card: FLAT CLAIM: CONTEXT MISSING.
options.why: Simpler.

lines.line: Lekin main honest rahunga. Kuch purane scholars ne bhi ise flat hi samjha tha, jaise Tafsir Jalalayn.

options.visual: A real Tafsir al-Jalalayn manuscript page (public-domain scan, to source) as a B&W cut-out; the 88:20 passage highlighted; English: "sutihat shows the earth is flat" - al-Mahalli, d. 1459 CE / 864 AH.
options.text: Some classical scholars read it as flat
options.why: The honesty beat needs the real source on screen, not a claim about it.

options.visual: Tight framing, no graphics on "main honest rahunga"; at Jalalayn a small parchment card with the quote and dates.
options.why: The channel's signature line gets the speaker's face.

lines.line: Par Imam Razi ne isi verse pe likha, ki bahut badi ball ka har hissa *flat* hi dikhta hai.

options.visual: A huge 3D ball with a tiny figure standing on it; the camera drops to his eye level and the curve becomes a flat line. Parchment caption: al-Razi on 88:20, d. 1210 CE / 606 AH.
options.text: "A very large ball looks flat in every part" - al-Razi
options.why: Razi's argument is visual; show it happen.

options.visual: Top: speaker. Bottom: the same ball-to-flat zoom.
options.why: Keeps the speaker visible on a long line.

lines.line: Tum abhi jahan khade ho, zameen flat lag rahi hai na? Phir bhi gol hai.

options.visual: "Tum jahan khade ho": real phone-height footage of a flat road or field to the horizon; "Phir bhi gol hai": cut to the Blue Marble earth, round. Mid-video FOLLOW animation after this line.
options.sound: breath, then a clean hit on "gol"
options.why: The viewer's own ground proves Razi's point; callback to the hook globe.

options.visual: Speaker gestures at the ground; small globe icon on "gol"; FOLLOW animation after.
options.why: Simpler.

lines.line: Ab ande wala claim. Surah Nazi'at ke verse 30 mein word hai "dahaha" (دَحَىٰهَآ).

options.visual: New torn card 79:30 (fetched), orange tag, the word ringed. A hard wipe from the flat half signals the second claim.
options.why: Same card grammar as 88:20, so the viewer feels the pattern.

options.visual: Top: 79:30 card. Bottom: the egg post from the hook returns.
options.why: Callback to the hook's second claim.

lines.line: Kehte hain, matlab shutur-murg ka anda. Par dictionary mein iska matlab bhi wahi hai, *phailana*.

options.visual: Real ostrich egg photo (licence to check) labelled EGG; on "dictionary mein" a lexicon page slides over; EGG is struck through and SPREAD OUT written beside it.
options.why: The correction happens on the same object.

options.visual: Card: dahaha = spread out, with the sutihat card returning beside it.
options.why: Shows "bhi wahi" as two matching cards.

lines.line: Shutur-murg se rishta hai, par ande ka nahi, uske *nest* ka.

options.visual: Real photo of an ostrich nest scrape in sand with eggs in it (Wikimedia, licence to check); NEST lands on the scrape, EGG fades.
options.why: The twist is a picture most viewers have never seen.

options.visual: Same nest photo with the speaker in a circle.
options.why: If the reveal needs the creator's reaction.

lines.line: Wo ret phaila ke nest banata hai, aur usi ko "udhiyy" (أُدْحِيّ) kehte hain.

options.visual: Footage of an ostrich scraping sand with its feet (licence to check); label: udhiyy = the nest it spreads out (Lane's Lexicon; Qurtubi on 79:30).
options.text: udhiyy: the nest it spreads out
options.why: Shows why the word means spreading.

options.visual: Card: udhiyy = the ostrich's spread-out nest (Lane; Qurtubi on 79:30).
options.why: If no usable ostrich footage.

lines.line: Toh ek ne verse se flat zameen nikaal li. Doosre ne anda.

options.visual: Both viral posts return side by side; the flat map and the egg peel out of the verse card like stickers; both get the same stamp: READ INTO IT.
options.text: Flat: read into it / Egg: read into it
options.sound: two stamp hits matching the hook
options.why: The payoff turns back on the hook: same two posts, same mistake.

options.visual: Speaker; the two FALSE stamps from line 3 return small on either side.
options.why: Simpler.

lines.line: Aur verse bas itna keh raha tha, dekho, ye zameen tumhare liye kaise *bichhayi* gayi.

options.visual: Back to the clean 88:20 card, word ringed, held still for 2+ s.
options.why: The last line returns to the verse itself, held 2 s (QUALITY 2).

options.visual: Speaker close, still, no graphics.
options.why: Lets the line breathe.

lines.line: Aise aur viral claims ke liye follow kar lo.

options.visual: Instagram and Facebook Follow animation with the real icons, plus the comment icon and question.
options.text: Follow for more viral claim checks / Which viral claim should we check next?
options.why: QUALITY 2a: topic-tied CTA and a specific comment question.

options.visual: Short end card: series name VIRAL CLAIM CHECK, follow icons, comment question.
options.text: VIRAL CLAIM CHECK / Which claim next?
options.why: Builds the series identity.
